name: General Aptitude
description: Verbal and numerical aptitude common to all GATE papers. High return on effort; practice regularly.

name: Engineering Mathematics
description: Discrete mathematics, linear algebra, calculus, probability and statistics for GATE CS.

name: Digital Logic
description: Boolean algebra, combinational and sequential circuits, number systems.

name: Computer Organization and Architecture
description: Machine instructions, ALU, datapath, control, memory hierarchy, pipelining, I/O.

name: Programming and Data Structures
description: C programming, recursion, arrays, stacks, queues, linked lists, trees, heaps, graphs.

name: Algorithms
description: Asymptotic analysis, divide and conquer, greedy, dynamic programming, graph algorithms.

name: Theory of Computation
description: Regular languages, context-free languages, Turing machines, decidability.

name: Compiler Design
description: Lexical analysis, parsing, syntax-directed translation, code generation.

name: Operating Systems
description: Processes, threads, scheduling, synchronization, deadlocks, memory and file systems.

name: Databases (DBMS)
description: ER model, relational algebra, SQL, normalization, transactions, indexing.

name: Computer Networks
description: OSI/TCP-IP, routing, congestion, IP addressing, TCP/UDP, application protocols.
